originalTitle: S&P 500, Nasdaq Futures Dip As Weaker-Than-Expected Alphabet Earnings Reignite AI Spending Worries — GOOGL, MSFT, ORCL, NVDA, MRVL In Focus
summary: The Federal Reserve left interest rates unchanged in its October policy meeting.
content: The S&P 500 ended Wednesday 0.3% higher, the Nasdaq 100 rose 0.5%, and the Dow Jones Industrial Average added 0.2%.The Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) voted 10–2 to maintain interest rates at 3.75%–4%.Alphabet missed Q3 earnings expectations, while Microsoft surpassed.U.S. stock indices ended higher on Wednesday as the Federal Reserve’s decision to keep interest rates unchanged helped cool some inflation worries, while weak earnings from Alphabet led the Nasdaq 100 to drop after-hours. The S&P 500 ended Wednesday 0.3% higher, the Nasdaq 100 rose 0.5%, and the Dow Jones Industrial Average added 0.2%. The Russell 2000, which tracks small-cap stocks, added 0.4%.Meanwhile, Nasdaq-100 futures lost 1.2%. S&P 500 futures declined 0.5%, while Dow Jones Industrial Average futures lost 17 points, or 0.03% at the time of writing. The SPDR S&P 500 ETF (SPY) gained 0.6%, and the SPDR Dow Jones Industrial Average ETF (DIA) rose 0.2%. Meanwhile, the Nasdaq-100 tracking Invesco QQQ Trust (QQQ) ended 0.5% higher on Wednesday. Meanwhile, the VanEck Semiconductor ETF (SMH) and the iShares Semiconductor ETF jumped about 2% each on Wednesday as gains in AMD, Micron Tech (MU) and Broadcom (AVGO). The broader Vanguard Information Technology ETF (VGT) rose 0.6%.Retail sentiment on Stocktwits for SPY improved to ‘neutral’ from ‘bearish’, while it remained in ‘bearish’ territory for DIA and QQQ.US Market DriversIndexMoveCloseDow Jones Industrial Average0.2%52,475.10 S&P 5000.3%7,743.98 Nasdaq 1000.5%29,813.16 The Federal Reserve opted to keep its target interest rate steady on Wednesday, but financial markets focused on Chair Kevin Warsh's announcement of a structural shift in the frequency of future interest rate decisions. The central bank held interest rates steady at 3.75% to 4% amid elevated inflation and a strong job market. The Federal Open Market Committee approved the following statement for release by a 10–2 vote.Under Warsh’s revamped framework, the FOMC will issue rate decisions at seven of its eight scheduled sessions in 2027, reserving one meeting exclusively for broad monetary policy strategy without issuing a formal rate statement. By 2028, the central bank plans to reduce its rate-setting votes to six per year, leaving two gatherings devoted entirely to strategic evaluations.“The Fed appears comfortable being patient for now as financial conditions have evolved broadly in line with expectations,” Luis Alvarado at Wells Fargo Investment Institute told Bloomberg. “But patience should not be confused with complacency.” Meanwhile, Alphabet Inc. (GOOG, GOOGL) shares slid about 11% after-hours after it reported third-quarter financial results that highlighted strong top-line revenue growth across its core digital ad and cloud operations, though massive investments in artificial intelligence infrastructure and investment losses squeezed profitability.These corporate reports arrive as Wall Street sharpens its focus on the artificial intelligence ecosystem. Following a prolonged pullback throughout much of October, AI-linked funds like the iShares Semiconductor ETF and the Roundhill Memory ETF have mounted a fresh rebound in recent trading sessions.Key Trending StocksOracle Corp. (ORCL) share price rallied about 11% on Wednesday, closing its best day since May this year, after executives unveiled a net cash-flow-positive outlook, helping alleviate capex concerns. Microsoft Corp. (MSFT) share price inched 3% higher after-hours on Wednesday after the software maker’s first-quarter results surpassed Wall Street expectations, propelled by surging demand for its artificial intelligence tools and cloud computing platform. Shares of Nvidia Corp (NVDA) slipped 1% on Wednesday following reports that the U.S. Department of Justice has inquired about how its planned acquisition of Hugging Face could affect competition in artificial intelligence. Shares of Lumentum Holdings Inc (LITE) soared 10% after hours on Wednesday following a report that Marvell Technology is in talks to buy it in a potential megadeal. chineseTitle: Alphabet 盈利弱于预期，标准普尔 500 指数和纳斯达克期货下跌，重新引发 AI 支出担忧——GOOGL、MSFT、ORCL、NVDA、MRVL 成为焦点
chineseSummary: 美联储在 10 月份政策会议上维持利率不变。
chineseContent: 标准普尔 500 指数周三收高 0.3%，纳斯达克 100 指数上涨 0.5%，道琼斯工业平均指数上涨 0.2%。联邦公开市场委员会 (FOMC) 以 10 比 2 的投票结果维持利率在 3.75%–4% 的水平。Alphabet 第三季度盈利低于预期，而微软则超越美国。由于美联储维持利率不变的决定帮助缓解了一些通胀担忧，周三股指收高，而 Alphabet 的疲弱盈利导致纳斯达克 100 指数盘后下跌。标准普尔 500 指数周三收高 0.3%，纳斯达克 100 指数上涨 0.5%，道琼斯工业平均指数上涨 0.2%。追踪小盘股的罗素 2000 指数上涨 0.4%。与此同时，纳斯达克 100 指数期货下跌 1.2%。截至撰写本文时，标准普尔 500 指数期货下跌 0.5%，而道琼斯工业平均指数期货下跌 17 点，即 0.03%。 SPDR S&P 500 ETF (SPY)上涨0.6%，SPDR道琼斯工业平均指数ETF (DIA)上涨0.2%。与此同时，追踪 Invesco QQQ Trust (QQQ) 的纳斯达克 100 指数周三收高 0.5%。与此同时，随着 AMD、美光科技 (MU) 和博通 (AVGO) 的上涨，VanEck Semiconductor ETF (SMH) 和 iShares Semiconductor ETF 周三各上涨约 2%。更广泛的 Vanguard 信息技术 ETF (VGT) 上涨 0.6%。Stocktwits 的零售情绪对 SPY 从“看跌”改善至“中性”，而 DIA 和 QQQ 仍处于“看跌”区域。美国市场驱动因素指数移动收盘道琼斯工业平均指数 0.2%52,475.10 标准普尔 5000.3%7,743.98 纳斯达克1000.5%29,813.16 美联储周三选择维持目标利率不变，但金融市场关注的是主席凯文·沃什宣布的未来利率决策频率的结构性转变。央行维持利率稳定在3.75%至4%
